hero_headline: Mountain roots. A family name. A craft built over generations.
hero_lead: Showtime began in 1986 as a specialty coach and custom-vehicle business and grew into the collision repair facility mountain drivers know today.
story_lead: Third-generation automotive craftsman Mark Makeig and his wife Lisa, together with Gilbert Nava and their parents Armando and Martha Nava, established Showtime Custom Coach, Inc. in October 1986.
story_body1: Early work included limousine manufacturing, specialty vehicle construction, automotive furnishings, and vehicle armoring. Over time, the company’s craftsmanship and problem-solving evolved into complex collision repair for the San Bernardino mountain communities and surrounding Inland Empire.
story_body2: Today, the next generation continues that family operation with a focus on technical training, modern repair capability, customer communication, and work that the team is willing to stand behind.
